subject: general
question: Four years ago, Shyam's age was (3)/(4) times that of Ram. Four years hence, Shyam’s age will be (5)/(6) times that of Ram. What is the present age of Shyam?
solution:
Given:

Four years ago, Shyam's age was (3)/(4) times that of Ram. 

Four years hence, Shyam’s age will be (5)/(6) times that of Ram

Calculation:

Four years ago ratio of Ram and Shyam’s age = 4x : 3x

According to the question

(4x+8)/(3x+8)= (6)/(5)

⇒ 20x + 40 = 18x + 48

⇒ 2x = 8

⇒ x = 4

Hence, x = 4

Shyam’s present age = 3 × 4 + 4 = 12 + 4 = 16 years

**∴ Present age of Shyam is 16 years.**
